_SectionSummary.summary: Binary search finds a value in a sorted array by repeatedly dividing the search interval in half.

_SummaryDraft.overview: This document explains binary search, an efficient algorithm that finds a value in a sorted array by repeatedly dividing the search interval in half.

key_concepts.definition: An algorithm that finds a value in a sorted array by repeatedly dividing the search interval in half.

takeaways.title: Efficient searching
takeaways.text: Binary search is much faster than checking every element one by one.

sections.title: How binary search works
sections.content: Binary search finds a value in a sorted array by repeatedly dividing the search interval in half and comparing the target value to the middle element.

questions.question: What does binary search repeatedly divide in half?
questions.explanation: Binary search repeatedly divides the search interval in half.
